text:
emily_sales: Heads up — AcmeDocs wants a temporary throughput uplift for a product launch. They asked for ~3x tokens/day for 72h starting tomorrow morning. Can we fast-track?

alex_cheng: Filed intake and started triage. Ticket #12345. Need fraud + billing checks before any manual quota change.

ticket-bot: Ticket #12345 created by emily_sales — priority: high, tag: quota-uplift.

ops-bot: Auto-check results: payment method on file, account age 14d, recent usage spike flagged for 2/Mar. No linked accounts detected.

priya: Can you paste a sample of their request distribution or IPs? Burst patterns matter for our heuristics.

emily_sales: They run doc-conversion -> embeddings heavy. Current ~10M tokens/day typical, they want to hit ~30M/day for the launch window. Single tenant, single billing. I'll DM the sample logs to Priya.

mike_s: If this is time-limited we can do a conditional uplift: short window (24-72h), per-min rate cap, active monitoring + automatic rollback. Need to define thresholds and rollback triggers.

alex_cheng: Proposal from support: provisional 48h uplift at 2x (not full 3x) with a hard cap of 500 requests/min and token-per-minute limit 200k, enable verbose ratecap logging and pager alert at 70% capacity. Anyone object?

priya: Did a quick fraud heuristic pass on the sample. No clear credential-stuffing or multi-account fraud. There was one burst on 2/Mar from a single IP range that looks anomalous but could be legitimate load. Recommend identity confirmation (invoice/billing match) + IP allowlist for the uplift window.

emily_sales: They sent a signed LOI and corporate billing address; sales vouches. I'll request official contact and outbound IP ranges this afternoon.

mike_s: Product OK with provisional uplift given fraudops + sales vouch. Also request we enable fallback routing to a smaller model variant if latency or queue depth exceeds SLOs — reduces cost and keeps service online. Post-uplift we should run quality checks on a prompt set.

priya: Agree. I'll set a 24h manual review checkpoint and will escalate immediately on anomalies (sudden geo shifts, new accounts, or proxy indicators). Also require IP allowlist and billing verification as preconditions.

alex_cheng: I'll update ticket #12345 with the exact config and preconditions. Config snippet I'll apply: ```quota_change: { tenant: "acmedocs", duration: "48h", multiplier: 2, req_per_min: 500, tokens_per_min: 200000 }```

emily_sales: :thumbsup: I'll notify the customer about the conditional uplift and ask for the IP ranges + launch start time.

ops-bot: Deploy action: quota-change executed for tenant "acmedocs" — multiplier=2, req_per_min=500, tokens_per_min=200000. Audit id: qc-202503-774.

alex_cheng: Looping back to product: please add an item to investigate automated, risk-based quota approvals so we don't do manual handoffs every time. This will go to backlog.

mike_s: Creating PL ticket now: "Quota uplift policy — risk-based approvals and automation". Assign to Priya (fraud gating) and Alex (support automation). Target: Q2 planning review.

emily_sales: Customer confirmed launch window: starts 09:00 PST tomorrow. I'll be on standby for rollback contact. Thanks team.

priya: I'll monitor alerts and run the 24h review. Update ticket with any anomalies.

alex_cheng: Closing thread here — ticket updated, provisional uplift applied, product backlog item created. Will follow up after 24h review.
